name: use-discatsharp
tagline_zh: 写 Discord 机器人卡在 API 细节？这个技能直接给版本匹配的 C# 示例，连重载选择都帮你搞定。
tagline_en: Stuck on DisCatSharp API details? Get version-matched C# examples, overload picks, and migration help—all in one.
desc_en: Build, explain, migrate, or troubleshoot Discord applications that use DisCatSharp. Use for DisCatSharp setup, configuration, clients, events, intents, slash commands, CommandsNext, interactivity, hosting, Lavalink, voice, entities, REST operations, exact API lookup, overload selection, and version-aware C# examples.
why_zh: 它按你的 DisCatSharp 版本精准输出代码，连重载签名都核对，比翻文档快十倍。
why_en: It matches your exact DisCatSharp version and verifies overload signatures—faster than digging through docs.
